evidence: Labeled 'Validation' and modifies FlushStateToDisk in src/validation.cpp alongside block storage management in src/node/blockstorage.{cpp,h}.
rationale: Fixes a disk space leak where block files scheduled for pruning were dropped from memory if a flush failed before writing the block index. While it ensures proper disk cleanup without requiring a node restart and assists kernel pruning test coverage, the failure mode is an edge case that resolves on restart.
